signal: A callable contains more authored code lines than the configured maximum.
why_it_matters: A large callable can conceal multiple responsibilities and make focused testing harder.
review: NON-NEGOTIABLE RESEARCH: Perform an external research/tool call to {reference_url} and read the page before reviewing this finding or proposing or applying remediation. If the URL cannot be consulted, report the reference research as incomplete and stop. Inspect control-flow regions, state changes, error paths, and focused tests.
remediation: Extract coherent steps into named callables or a focused class/module while preserving behavior with tests.

signal: A callable declares more parameters than the configured maximum.
why_it_matters: Many inputs can obscure call-site intent or indicate a missing domain value.
review: NON-NEGOTIABLE RESEARCH: Perform an external research/tool call to {reference_url} and read the page before reviewing this finding or proposing or applying remediation. If the URL cannot be consulted, report the reference research as incomplete and stop. Inspect recurring parameter groups, optional modes, and call-site readability.
remediation: Introduce a cohesive parameter object/value or split independent operations rather than hiding unrelated inputs.

signal: A class declares more source-owned fields than the configured maximum.

remediation: Extract cohesive field groups and their invariants into focused values or classes.

signal: A class declares more source-owned methods than the configured maximum.

signal: The sum of a class's authored method lines exceeds the configured maximum.
